_note: Reference participant and tool by name (participantName / toolName) or by id (participantId / toolId); id wins if both are present. Names must match exactly (case-insensitive) and uniquely — an ambiguous name errors, telling you to use the id. Load tools.json first so the tools exist. level is one of: BASIC, DOF, CERTIFIED, INSTRUCTOR, MAY_CERTIFY_OTHERS.
